messages:
Izumi Jin: Hi all — Izumi here, just started on Platform (UTC+9). Day zero checklist: no MDM invite yet, VPN not installed, and Im waiting on laptop enrollment. Also I make tiny pixel art and trade stickers if anyone's into that :pixel_art: :wave:

Maya Lin: welcome Izumi!! Im your onboarding buddy. I can walk you through the runbooks and slack channels. Want a 1:1 at 14:00 your local tomorrow? Also what snack should we put in your welcome box? :cup_with_straw:

Connor Patel: hey Izumi, good to have you. No rush today  focus on access. Ill add you to the sprint board and invite you to our infra sync tomorrow.

mdm-bot: Automated message: enrollment email sent to izumi@redwood.example. If you dont see it check spam or use manual enroll: https://mdm.redwood.internal/enroll?user=izumi

Sam Ortiz: @Izumi I'm IT. Quick steps below (mac/linux). Happy to remote in if you want live help.
```
macOS:
1) open enrollment link from the email
2) double-click .mobileconfig and follow prompts
3) install Redwood VPN client: https://downloads.redwood.internal/vpn

Ubuntu:
sudo dpkg -i redwood-vpn.deb
sudo systemctl enable --now redwood-vpn
redwood-vpn login --user izumi
```

Sam Ortiz: Also set up MFA: Settings > Security > Add MFA (TOTP). YubiKey optional put a hardware request here if you need one: https://peopleops.redwood.internal/hardware-requests

Priya Rao: hi Izumi  welcome! People Ops will DM you the swag form. Headphone/office stipend up to $200; request via https://forms.redwood.internal/welcome-equipment

Izumi Jin: Thanks! Quick Q: any recommended monitor arm for a standing desk so I order the right VESA size? Also how long does hardware typically take?

Sam Ortiz: Ergotron LX or Amazon Basics arms are usually fine. Paste the Amazon link in the hardware request. Typical lead time: 3-7 business days standard, 7-14 for special orders.

Maya Lin: Ill send a 30m pairing invite for tomorrow 14:00 JST to go through repos and dev env. And yes to pixel sticker swaps  bring sprites to #random later :sticker:

Izumi Jin: Enrolling now. Will ping if anything fails. Excited to be here  I might add a tiny redwood sprite to my prompt :sparkles:

Connor Patel: :tada: welcome again. FYI theres a first-week-goals doc pinned in onboarding channel, super lightweight.

Maya Lin: welcome party in #random at 17:00 JST  virtual ramen and sticker show-and-tell 35c

Izumi Jin: See you there  thanks everyone!
